## Summary

## Contract and compatibility

- [ ] Opcodes `0–100` retain their existing meaning.
- [ ] Serialized changes include fixtures or migration notes.
- [ ] Lifecycle ownership and cleanup are tested where relevant.
- [ ] New plugin capabilities are explicit and least-privilege.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] Browser/device evidence attached when rendering, media, or accessibility changes

## Licensing

- [ ] No unlicensed game-derived material was added.
- [ ] New third-party or generated material includes provenance and license evidence.
